title: Path integral for the closed superstring and the matrix model
summary: The IKKT matrix model, which is proposed as a non-perturbative formulation of superstring theory, has an issue typical of zero-dimensional theory -- ambiguity in the definition of its path integral. To tackle this issue, we revisit the path-integral formulation of perturbative string theory. In this article, we review recent progress in the string world-sheet path-integral formulation, especially in the Minkowski signature.
